tier14.subject: Asmekti wis sin — tafaṭurt {displayNumber} iɛedda lawan n usellek-is
tier14.body_one:
Azul,

Tafaṭurt {displayNumber}, n {amountOutstanding}, azemz n uxelleṣ-is yella d {dueDate}, yerna tura iɛedda lawan-is s {{count}} n wussan. Wa d asmekti-nneɣ wis sin — ma ulac aɣilif, xellṣet-tt s zreb ma tzemrem.

Ma yella tesɛam uguren deg usellek, ma ulac aɣilif nermset-aɣ-d iwakken ad naf tifrat lwaḥid.

tier30.subject: S LEMƔAWLA — tafaṭurt {displayNumber} iɛedda lawan-is s waṭas
tier30.body_one:
Azul,

Tafaṭurt {displayNumber}, n {amountOutstanding}, azemz n usellek-is yella d {dueDate}, yerna tura iɛedda lawan-is s {{count}} n wussan. Ɣas akken i nceyyeɛ-awen-d ismektiyen, mazal-itt ur tettwasellek ara.

Ma ulac aɣilif, selket tafaṭurt-a TURA KAN iwakken ur wen-d-ttilint ara tigawin nniḍen. Nermset-aɣ-d s lemɣawla ma yella kra iɣef ur nemsefham ara, neɣ ma yella kra n wugur, ar tura, ur d-newwi ara lexber yis-s.

{companyName}
